title: Mute icon
description: The file game/tuning/mute_icon.json: the muted-music icon's margin, its size and its two colors, read in both run modes. DRA-159. The file must exist and every field is required: nothing has a default in code. The values are the GDD's mute_icon_look (10-ui.md, guess); the colors are picks from the palettes in 12-art-and-audio.md. margin and size are read by game/app/mute_icon_tuning.py at startup into ui.mute_icon.MuteIconLook; size and both colors are also read by tools/art/mute_icon.py, which bakes assets/mute_icon.png from them. Rules the schema cannot express are in docs/contracts/systems/mute-icon.md, Rules, Loading (the icon's rectangle lies inside the window and does not touch the play area). Owner of the schema: architect. Contract: docs/contracts/systems/mute-icon.md.

margin.description: Distance in px from the window's right edge and from its bottom edge to the icon. An integer, never a bool. Maps to MuteIconLook.margin. GDD: mute_icon_look.

size.description: Width and height of the icon in px on screen. The picture assets/mute_icon.png must be exactly this size. An integer, never a bool. Maps to MuteIconLook.size. GDD: mute_icon_look.

speaker_color.description: The speaker's color: a pale violet-white from the palettes in 12-art-and-audio.md, as #rrggbb. Read by tools/art/mute_icon.py only. GDD: mute_icon_look.

slash_color.description: The slash's color: a fuchsia from the palettes in 12-art-and-audio.md, as #rrggbb. Read by tools/art/mute_icon.py only. GDD: mute_icon_look.
